messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: HIGH error-rate detected — inference-service (eu-west-1). Metric: 5xx_rate > 1.0% over 5m. Pages: @maria gonzalez, @kevin park. Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.io/d/infra/inference-regional?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1 IncidentID: INC-2026-0315-42 :rotating_light:

maria gonzalez: acked — jumping on it. opening dashboards now, tagging eng-sre for visibility. can someone check cluster-level OOMs and recent deploys?

ajay singh: seeing elevated GC and a few OOM kills on model-worker pods in eu-west-1 over the last 10m. No deploys in the last hour. Logs show repeated 'CUDA out of memory' on v2026.03.10-prod model container.

maria gonzalez: copy. running quick mitigation: scale worker pool and shift traffic. executing:```sh
# scale up worker replicas in eu-west-1
kubectl --context=eu-west-1 scale deploy inference-worker-eu --replicas=20 -n inference-prod
# increase autoscaler min to avoid immediate downscale
kubectl -n infra patch hpa inference-worker-eu -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'
```

srebot: Suggested automated mitigation: enable model fallback to `gptx-quant-8bit` for requests that hit memory pressure and apply token cap 512 for affected region. See runbook step 4. :gear:

leah wong: For customer impact — we’re seeing 502/504 spikes on `/v1/generate` for a small subset of EU customers behind dedicated capacity. CX flagged two enterprise customers with timeouts. Can we put a temporary routing rule to divert a fraction to us-east-1 to reduce user-visible errors?

maria gonzalez: executing weighted routing change now.```
# Change traffic split in prod-edge to send 30% eu-west -> us-east
curl -XPOST https://edge-admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/split -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","regionWeights":{"eu-west-1":70,"us-east-1":30}}'
```

ajay singh: after scaling and routing change, error-rate dropped from 1.6% -> 0.4% in eu-west over the next 3 minutes. Latency also stabilized. Looks like memory pressure was causing queue backpressure.

maria gonzalez: nice. I’ll keep the fallback to quantized model enabled for 30m and monitor. Also going to mute the eu-west 5xx pager for 30m to avoid alert churn while we confirm stability.

leah wong: +1 on muting, but we should not lose the signal — create a reduced-sensitivity alert group and a synthetic canary for eu-west route. I’ll open an ops ticket to add a per-route 1min synthetic check.

maria gonzalez: creating ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OP-4821 — add canary, per-route dashboards, and update alert thresholds.

kevin park: FYI, I’m taking handoff at 03:00 UTC. If you want me to run playbook steps after the initial mitigation, ping me in this thread. I’ll own follow-up and postmortem.

maria gonzalez: thanks @kevin park — handoff notes: scaled workers, bumped HPA min, applied weighted routing 70/30 -> (eu-west/us-east), enabled fallback to quantized model, muted 5xx pager for eu-west for 30m, opened OP-4821. Current status: errors trending down, no new OOMs in last 8m.

ajay singh: monitoring shows increased cross-region traffic ~28% shift to us-east. We should add an alert for cross-region imbalance > 15% over 5m to catch future automated splits or network blips early.

maria gonzalez: adding rule to alerting config now:```yaml
- alert: RegionalTrafficImbalance
  expr: abs(region_request_ratio{region="eu-west-1"} - region_baseline_ratio{region="eu-west-1"}) > 0.15
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```

srebot: Note: muting the 5xx alert will silence pages but will still log incidents to the incident index. Recommend adding a temporary slack notifier on the new synthetic canary so eng-sre sees failures without paging.

leah wong: Also propose adjusting 5xx alert window from 5m to 3m and changing threshold from 1.0% to 1.5% as a short-term reduction of flapping. We'll document rationale in the ticket.

maria gonzalez: accepted. I updated the prometheus rule: 5xx_rate > 1.5% over 3m for eu-west-1 (temporary). Rolling back to previous after stabilization will be part of OP-4821.

ajay singh: quick reminder: this was triggered by model memory footprint growth on v2026.03.10 — we should snapshot heap and GPU memory usage and consider building a smaller quantized variant as permanent fallback.

kevin park: taking over now. I’ll keep the routing at 70/30 for another 30m, monitor for any error resurgence, and schedule a post-incident sync at 11:00 UTC to decide on permanent alert tuning and the model fallback plan. I’ll add owners to OP-4821: Ajay (memory analysis), Leah (canary + dashboard), Maria (runbook updates).

maria gonzalez: thanks. Final status update before handoff: error-rate eu-west1 0.3%, us-east1 0.08%, routing split 70/30, fallback active, HPA min 10, replicas 20. No active pages.

kevin park: acknowledged. Taking on-call. Follow-ups logged in OP-4821 and will write a short RCA draft after the sync. :white_check_mark:

srebot: Incident auto-close criteria: 5xx < 0.5% for 30m and no OOM events on model-worker pods in eu-west-1. If met, incident will be marked resolved and paging config will be restored.

maria gonzalez: resolved for now — leaving the thread open until follow-up sync. Great triage team effort. :clap:
